snippet.title: Garden of Witches - Steam Early Access Trailer Ver. 2
snippet.description:
Garden of Witches is a fast-paced action roguelike featuring strategic build combinations and finely tuned combat. 
Get it now on Steam and Stove!

■ Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530470
■ Stove : https://store.onstove.com/games/4207
■ Discord : https://discord.com/invite/QG4tJj2QWR
